subject: Gender-Affirming and Reproductive Health Care Ordinance
overview: The subcommittee met to review a proposed ordinance shielding patients and providers of gender-affirming and reproductive health care from out-of-state legal action. The committee voted to retain the paper while soliciting input from department heads and researching existing city ordinances.

items.title: Proposed Gender-Affirming and Reproductive Health Care Ordinance
items.summary: The subcommittee reviewed draft text restricting city resources and police cooperation from aiding out-of-state investigations into legal reproductive and gender-affirming care. The paper was kept in committee following motions to gather written feedback from department heads and local health institutions and to check for existing related city ordinances.
